text: Are you awake and responding normally, and do you have any severe chest pain, trouble breathing, or heavy bleeding right now?
Yes, I am awake and responding normally. I have no chest pain, trouble breathing, or heavy bleeding right now.
Can you tell me what happened, when it started, and how bad the pain is on a scale from 0 to 10?
I've had a sore throat for two days that hurts to swallow about a 3/10. It started two days ago.
Could you please tell me if you take any regular medications?
No, I don't take any regular medications. I have no allergies or medical conditions either.
Do you have any allergies to medicines, or are you immunocompromised, pregnant, or postpartum?
No, I have no allergies, conditions, or medications. I am not pregnant or postpartum.
Do you have any fever, rash, overseas travel in the last two weeks, or contact with anyone who is infectious?
No, I don't have a fever today and I haven't had a rash, traveled overseas, or been around anyone sick.
Could you please tell me when you last ate or drank, along with your name and date of birth for our hospital records?
I had soup about an hour ago. My name is [Name] and my date of birth is November 21, 2000.
